name: smwsprites-controllable-carrot-top-lift
title: Controllable Carrot Top Lift
description:
This carrot lift acts just like SMW's, except it can be controlled with the controller buttons. (It doesn't move by itself.) Depending on if X position of the sprite as it was placed at in Lunar Magic is odd or even, it faces either left or right. If the extra bit is set, it will only last for a matter of frames, then disappear in smoke. Credit not needed.

Now SA-1 hybrid.
